name: freelance-outreach-assistant
description: Local Codex tools for safe freelance outreach: lead research, CRM maintenance, email drafting, and daily follow-up planning.

interface.shortDescription: Research leads, draft emails, and plan follow-ups safely.
interface.longDescription: A repo-local assistant for validating a freelance outreach operation with a separate Gmail identity. It helps Codex research public leads, score opportunities, create email drafts, audit CRM data, and prepare daily outreach lists without sending bulk email automatically.
defaultPrompt: Prepare today's outreach list from my CRM.
Draft first-contact emails for qualified leads.
